h: Obi and Kwankwaso to lead "2 million-man march" in Uyo
p: NDC candidate Peter Obi and his running mate Rabiu Kwankwaso are set to lead a solidarity march in Uyo, Akwa Ibom, on Saturday 24 October from 9am at the Water Fountain on Nwaniba Road. Organisers say it was moved from 1 October over security and logistics.
